people.name: Beth-aven
people.line: Town and wilderness near Ai and Bethel.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Michmash
people.line: A town in Benjamin; site of Saul's camp and Jonathan's victory

people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

translations.web: The Philistines assembled themselves together to fight with Israel, thirty thousand chariots, and six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand which is on the seashore in multitude. They came up and encamped in Michmash, eastward of Beth Aven.
translations.bsb: Now the Philistines assembled to fight against Israel with three thousand chariots, six thousand horsemen, and troops as numerous as the sand on the seashore. They went up and camped at Michmash, east of Beth-aven.
translations.kjv: And the Philistines gathered themselves together to fight with Israel, thirty thousand chariots, and six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand which is on the sea shore in multitude: and they came up, and pitched in Michmash, eastward from Bethaven.
translations.asv: And the Philistines assembled themselves together to fight with Israel, thirty thousand chariots, and six thousand horsemen, and people as the sand which is on the sea-shore in multitude: and they came up, and encamped in Michmash, eastward of Beth-aven.
